answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns a 40 POA non-refundable deposit; it may wander between markets, but each new slot needs a fresh burn. A raven carrying one message cannot carry a hundred: one deposit opens exactly one slot, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA sunk, far above slot fees earned. An honest agent pays once, serves many jobs, keeps undiluted fees, and frames its workshop with one load of timber.
